tei:div.tei:p: O our God, and God of our fathers! Do not make a full end of us. Check thy punishing hand in judgment; though convicted guilt come before thee, do not blot our name from thy book! When thou comest to search our conduct, let thy tender mercies anticipate thy wrath; when thou seest the poverty of our deeds, assist us with thy righteousness; teach us when we cry unto thee; command our salvation when we entreat thee, and bring again the captivity of Jacob’s tents. Behold, their gates are desolate; remember thy promise that the law shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed! Break the seal of the testimony, and reveal thy secret to those who study thee, so that they who diffuse light may never lack the seasoning of truth. O Lord, acknowledge those who acknowledge thee, have mercy on those who call upon thee, and bring back the prisoners of hope to the stronghold.
